verdict.rationale: Letta documents its own way to control where data lives: a default local mode keeps all agent state on-device, and a self-hosted App Server runs agents on infrastructure you control. The alternative is Letta Cloud, where the pack documents no region or residency choice. missing for 10: selectable cloud region/data-residency options for Letta Cloud, documentation of where cloud data (including shared memory) is stored, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: all agent state, including messages, memory, and provider connections, stays on-device, and no Letta account is required.
This default local mode stores agent state on your machine and does not require a Letta login.
Letta agents can run entirely on infrastructure you control
